case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear Mr. Seidl,

Thank you for your quote and for setting out your cost drivers so openly. We value the years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both sides.

One point from our side belongs in the picture:

Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

With that in mind, we would like to propose a longer partnership:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.81; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.67; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.78; no index clause; payment 30 days net; contract term 36 months.

Each option gives you more planning security, and some also offer longer payment terms. We hope one of them works for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We value our long-standing partnership and acknowledge your note regarding our delivery performance. 

While we welcome the proposal for a 36-month contract, we cannot offer a fixed price over this extended period and must include an AS-14404 index clause to manage raw material volatility. With this index clause in place and maintaining the 30-day payment term, we can offer a revised price of €5.60 per unit. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit. This option features a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear Mr. Seidl,

Thank you for your reply and for taking our delivery data seriously. That is a constructive step, and we value the cooperation between our two family companies.

We have taken your position into account and prepared three options for you to consider. Each includes the index clause you asked for, and they differ in payment term, so you can choose the one that suits you best. Where we offer you faster payment, we have reflected it in the price.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.91; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.77; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.88; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 30 days net; contract term 36 months.

We hope one of these gives us a fair basis for both sides.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your message. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

We appreciate your acceptance of the AS-14404 index clause, which provides a fair basis for a 36-month contract. However, the price levels you propose remain unworkable for us. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We must therefore hold our offer at €5.60 per unit for a 60-day payment term. 

To confirm the full details, our offer stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our business relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and look forward to working together.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
